newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $156.1 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $156.1 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for February 6 are expected to total $156.1 million in 16 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $76.8 million in 14 sales. The largest is a $30.0 million Fresno Unified School District, Calif., at 1300 EST.
Negotiated sales total $79.4 million in two offerings. The largest is a $70 million Camden County Improvement Authority, N.J. revenue bond offering through Lehman Brothers.
Day-to-day muni bond sales total $104 million in three offerings for February 6, which means dealers have said they may bring the offerings to market if conditions warrant.
